guide.title: Save words straight from the text
guide.subtitle: Right-click any word in a lesson part or a video transcript — a small dock appears at your pointer. Right-clicking works on desktop.

step1.title: Right-click any word or phrase
step1.body: In lesson parts and video transcripts, %icon% a word — or drag-select a phrase first. The dock appears at your cursor.

step2.title: Save word
step2.body: %icon% opens the add-word dialog prefilled with the word and the sentence you met it in — draft with AI, review, save.

step3.title: Create deck
step3.body: %icon% makes a new deck on the spot — name it and the word lands inside it.

step4.title: Copy
step4.body: %icon% keeps the selection on your clipboard for your own notes.

guide.title: How vocabulary works
guide.subtitle: Save words from anywhere, let the AI draft the details, and keep everything organized in decks you review.

step1.title: Add a word
step1.body: Press %icon% to save any word or phrase to your personal list — only the term, definition, and level are required.

step2.title: Draft details with AI
step2.body: Press %icon% and the AI fills the definition, level, part of speech, IPA and examples. Pick the explanation language in the config first — review everything before saving.

step3.title: Group words into decks
step3.body: Save straight into a deck from the dialog, or make a new one with %icon% on the decks page. Decks keep what you review together.

step4.title: Review and track
step4.body: Filter by level or source, mark words %icon% after reviewing, and open any word for its full details.
step4.footer: Words saved from lessons and videos link back to where you met them.
